SendMessage.description: Sends a message in your Twitch chat. Cuebot sends it with its connected Twitch account; the bot and fallback settings are ignored. Empty text sends nothing.

SendYouTubeMessage.description: Sends a message in your YouTube chat. Give a broadcast id to post in that stream's chat, with the bot account (or the broadcaster as fallback). Empty text sends nothing.

SendKickMessage.description: Sends a message in your Kick chat. The bot and fallback settings are ignored. Empty text sends nothing.

SendMessageToAll.description: Sends the same message to every chat that is connected right now (Twitch, YouTube, Kick and others). A Cuebot extra. Fails when no chat is connected.

ObsIsConnected.description: Checks whether OBS answers right now. Give a connection number to check another OBS; 0 is the default one.
ObsIsConnected.returns: true when OBS answered, otherwise false.

ObsSetScene.description: Switches OBS to another scene, by its name exactly as OBS shows it. The connection number picks another OBS (0 is the default).

ObsGetCurrentScene.description: Asks OBS which scene is live right now.
ObsGetCurrentScene.returns: The scene's name, or empty text when OBS did not say.

ObsSetSourceVisibility.description: Shows (true) or hides (false) a source in an OBS scene. Fails when the scene has no source with that name.

ObsShowSource.description: Shows a source in an OBS scene, like your webcam. Fails when the scene has no source with that name.

ObsHideSource.description: Hides a source in an OBS scene. Fails when the scene has no source with that name.

ObsIsSourceVisible.description: Checks whether a source in an OBS scene is showing.
ObsIsSourceVisible.returns: true when the source is visible, otherwise false.

ObsToggleSource.description: Flips a source in an OBS scene: hides it when it shows, shows it when it is hidden.

ObsShowFilter.description: Turns on a filter in OBS. Give a scene or source name and the filter name. The version with scene and source turns on the source's filter (the scene is not used).

ObsHideFilter.description: Turns off a filter in OBS. Give a scene or source name and the filter name. The version with scene and source turns off the source's filter (the scene is not used).

ObsSetGdiText.description: Changes the words in an OBS text source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

ObsSetBrowserSource.description: Points an OBS browser source at a new web link. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

ObsSetImageSourceFile.description: Shows a different picture file in an OBS image source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

ObsSetMediaSourceFile.description: Loads a different video or sound file in an OBS media source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

ObsStartStreaming.description: Tells OBS to start streaming (go live).

ObsStopStreaming.description: Tells OBS to stop streaming (end the stream).

ObsIsStreaming.description: Checks whether OBS is live right now.
ObsIsStreaming.returns: true while OBS is streaming, otherwise false.

ObsIsRecording.description: Checks whether OBS is recording right now.
ObsIsRecording.returns: true while OBS is recording, otherwise false.

ObsSendRaw.description: Sends any OBS request by its name, with its data written as JSON text. For advanced users who know the obs-websocket requests.

TtsSpeak.description: Says a message out loud with one of your text-to-speech voices, picked by its alias from the Speech page. Tick the bad word filter to clean up the text first.

PlaySound.description: Plays a sound file. Volume goes from 0 to 1. With finishBeforeContinuing true, your code waits until the sound ends. The sound name (or file name) lets StopSoundPlayback stop it.

StopSoundPlayback.description: Stops the sounds playing with this name. The name is the sound name you gave PlaySound, or the file name without its ending.

StopAllSoundPlayback.description: Stops every sound that is playing right now.

DiscordPostTextToWebhook.description: Posts a message to a Discord channel through a webhook link. You can set the name and picture it posts with, and tick text-to-speech. Fails when Discord refuses.
DiscordPostTextToWebhook.returns: The new message's id, or empty text when Discord did not say.
DiscordPostTextToWebhook.example:
string id = CPH.DiscordPostTextToWebhook("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/123/abc", "We are live!", "Stream Bot");
CPH.LogInfo($"Posted message {id}");
